==Usage==
<pre><nowiki>{{Talkheader}}</nowiki></pre>
Results in:
{{Talkheader}}
<pre><nowiki>{{Talkheader|comment=This is a comment}}</nowiki></pre>
Results in:
{{Talkheader|comment=This is a comment}}
